headline: Fed signals steady rates as inflation cools further
summary: The Federal Reserve indicated it would hold rates steady at its next meeting as inflation continued to trend toward its 2% target.

headline: Tech stocks rally on strong earnings from major cloud providers
summary: Shares of leading cloud infrastructure companies climbed after quarterly results beat analyst expectations across the board.

headline: Oil prices dip amid rising global supply concerns
summary: Crude oil futures fell as OPEC+ signaled it may increase production quotas in the coming quarter.
